answer.original_source: SemiAnalysis, reported by The Decoder on 2026-07-06; the original report is a rumour and says the planned NVL72x2 design, which would have placed two Oberon racks back to back, was scrapped entirely.
answer.new_information: The NVL72x2 cancellation is a repeat of the claim already recorded in e101, also attributed to SemiAnalysis. It adds no independent confirmation and does not change the separate claim that Kyber NVL144 was delayed to 2028. The cancellation is relevant context for v11, but the same design cancellation was already in that question’s evidence.

arguments.statement: Will Nvidia launch the Kyber NVL144 rack architecture by 2027-12-31? The current lean remains No: SemiAnalysis reported that Kyber NVL144 had been delayed to 2028 (e64, e66, e98), while NVIDIA’s statement that its roadmap was intact is a countervailing but nonspecific company response (e65, e102). The newly received report that the NVL72x2 alternative was scrapped does not change that assessment because the same cancellation was already reported in e101; it is not additional confirmation of the Kyber delay. Neither outcome is established.
limitations: The delay and cancellation reports are attributed to SemiAnalysis and are rumour, not confirmed NVIDIA roadmap changes.
The incoming report repeats e101 and is not an independent source.
NVIDIA’s statement that its roadmap was intact does not specify Kyber timing or directly resolve the reported delay.
what_would_change_it: NVIDIA confirmation or an authoritative roadmap update establishing whether Kyber NVL144 will launch by 2027-12-31.
A confirmed launch or shipment before the deadline, or evidence that the launch will occur after it.
